# Tenancy, caching, throttling and idempotency

See [Multi-tenancy](../guide/tenancy.md), [HTTP caching](../guide/conditional.md),
[Throttling](../guide/throttling.md) and [Hooks and idempotency](../guide/hooks.md).

### `current_tenant()`

```python
def current_tenant(request: HttpRequest) -> object | None: ...
```

The tenant already resolved for this request, or `None`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `request` | `HttpRequest` | — | The current request. |

### `conditional()`

```python
def conditional(*, from_body: bool = True) -> Callable[[F], F]: ...
```

An operation decorator adding `ETag` and 304 handling to successful GET responses.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from_body` | `bool` | `True` | Hash the rendered body when no tag was set with `remember_etag`. |

### Throttles

| Class | Arguments | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `RateThrottle` | `rate: str \| None = None, *, cache: str = 'default'` | Base class: `rate` requests per window for each identity from `identify()`. |
| `UserRateThrottle` | — | Per authenticated user (`request.auth` or `request.user`); anonymous requests pass. |
| `AnonRateThrottle` | — | Per client IP for anonymous requests; authenticated requests pass. |
| `ClientRateThrottle` | `*, user: str \| None = None, anon: str \| None = None, cache: str = 'default'` | One throttle, two rates: `ClientRateThrottle(user="600/min", anon="30/min")`. |
| `ScopedRateThrottle` | `scope: str, *, cache: str = 'default'` | A named limit whose rate comes from `NINJA_DEVX["THROTTLE_RATES"][scope]`. |
| `TenantRateThrottle` | `rate: str, *, tenant: Callable[[HttpRequest], object] \| None = None, cache: str = 'default'` | Per tenant: the tenant already resolved, `request.tenant`, or `tenant(request)`. |

### `idempotent()`

```python
def idempotent(*, header: str = 'Idempotency-Key', ttl: int | None = None, database: str | None = None, required: bool = False, scope: Callable[[HttpRequest], str] | None = None) -> ViewDecorator: ...
```

Replay completed responses after authentication, permissions and bindings.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `header` | `str` | `'Idempotency-Key'` | Request header carrying a key of at most 255 characters. |
| `ttl` | `int \| None` | `None` | Completed response retention; defaults to `IDEMPOTENCY_TTL`. |
| `database` | `str \| None` | `None` | Durable database alias; defaults to `IDEMPOTENCY_DATABASE`. |
| `required` | `bool` | `False` | Reject a missing key with HTTP 400. |
| `scope` | `Callable[[HttpRequest], str] \| None` | `None` | Stable custom principal and tenant identity, if not model/scalar values. |
